subject: Life Skills
title: Conflict Is Not Always Bad
description: A micro-lesson that makes Conflict Is Not Always Bad usable.

hook.text: Teams that never disagree underperform teams with healthy conflict, according to Google's Project Aristotle.

buildup.text: Avoiding conflict feels peaceful but buries problems. Unresolved tension always surfaces later, worse.

discovery.text: Productive conflict challenges ideas, not people. It sharpens thinking and exposes blind spots safely.

twist.text: The goal isn't eliminating conflict. It's learning to handle it so everyone grows rather than retreats.

climax.text: Welcome disagreement as a signal that people care enough to speak up. Silence is the real danger.

punchline.text: Healthy conflict builds. Avoided conflict destroys.

quiz.question: Why can conflict be beneficial in teams?
options: It challenges ideas and exposes blind spots
It forces leaders to make all decisions
